title: Vibrant Tangy Egyptian Morning Glory Stir Fry
description: A flexitarian-friendly Egyptian dish featuring morning glory pak bung, stir-fry, with a tangy and springy flavor, perfect for an adventurous meal. This recipe combines the freshness of morning glory with the warmth of Egyptian spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the morning glory pak bung and cook until it is tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice, salt, black pepper, cumin, and coriander.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer the stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the Vibrant Tangy Egyptian Morning Glory Stir Fry hot, garnished with lemon wedges.
